resources.string: This optional service locks the screen when you request it. It does not read screen content or typed text. To enable it, find Power&volume in Accessibility settings.
This optional service displays a persistent notification with lock and volume controls. It may restart after a reboot or update. You can turn it off at any time.
Enable Device Administrator or Accessibility to lock the screen.
Device Administrator: Lock the screen. After disabling it, screen lock may need Accessibility. You can also uninstall the app.
